title: Opposite operations
text: The variable is on one side with a constant multiple. Remove the constant by dividing by the multiple.

title: Balance both sides
text: We divide the left side by $$-4$$ to isolate the variable, we must divide the right side by $$-4$$ to keep the equation balanced.\n $$\frac{\left(-4x\right)}{\left(-4\right)}=\frac{20}{\left(-4\right)}$$
